shots.shot_intent: Hands rinse a mug without the person looking; the automatic gesture is the hook.
shots.description: Two hands in a dark-green knit sweater rinse a white ceramic mug under a thin stream of water in a steel sink, lit by one warm pendant lamp, deep blue shadows beyond
shots.action: the hands turn the mug under the water slowly; the head is out of frame
shots.lighting: warm pendant from above, cool blue ambient from the window
shots.continuity_notes: establishes the mug, sink and lamp

shots.shot_intent: Show the whole ritual in one frame: person, mug, window.
shots.description: An adult in a dark-green knit sweater with medium-length dark hair, seen from behind, stands at the counter under the pendant lamp holding the white mug, the window a cool blue rectangle with condensation
shots.action: a small shift of weight; nothing else
shots.lighting: pendant pool on the counter, window glow on the shoulders
shots.continuity_notes: same sweater, same mug, same lamp

shots.shot_intent: Name it plainly over the emptiest frame: the mug alone on the counter.
shots.description: The white mug alone on the wooden counter in the pendant's amber pool, a ring of water beneath it, the rest of the kitchen falling into blue shadow
shots.lighting: single warm pool, everything else cool

shots.shot_intent: The three parts of the loop laid over the person at the window.
shots.description: In profile, the adult in the dark-green sweater stands at the dark window, face lit cool blue on one side and warm amber on the other, mug held loosely, breath fogging a small patch of glass
shots.action: a slow push in as they exhale
shots.lighting: split light: cool window, warm lamp
shots.continuity_notes: same person, same mug, same window

shots.shot_intent: The experiment: the mug is on the other side, and the hand goes to the old place first.
shots.description: From above, the white mug sits on the left of the steel sink instead of the right; a hand in a dark-green knit sleeve reaches to the empty right side, pauses over bare wet steel, then corrects
shots.action: the hand reaches right, hovers, and moves left to the mug
shots.lighting: pendant from above, blue reflections in the sink
shots.continuity_notes: same sink and mug, mug now on the left

shots.shot_intent: Let it settle: the person from behind, the kitchen quiet, the mug in its new place.
shots.description: A wide view of the small night kitchen: the adult from behind at the counter, pendant lamp, blue window, the white mug on the left of the sink, the doorway dark in the foreground
shots.action: the lamp light barely flickers; they set the mug down
shots.lighting: one warm lamp in a blue room
shots.continuity_notes: everything as before, mug on the left

sequence_notes: Two moments of real motion (the rinse, the reach) and four holds. Cuts on line boundaries.
visual_through_line: one mug, one lamp, one window
